source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        bg = max(set(row), key=row.count)
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            if row[left] == row[right] and all(row[c] == bg for c in range(left + 1, right)):
                for c in range(left + 1, right):
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
